description: Receive earnest money, rents, and security deposits into the sales and property management escrow accounts; wire held deposits to title companies before closing; release owner distributions and deposit refunds
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Deposits must be placed by the end of the third business day (r. 61J2-14.008(3)); a held deposit must reach the title company before the closing date; one diverted wire can exceed a month of receipts. The 4-hour RTO is for a verified channel to the bank (phone and online banking with dual control). The 24-hour RPO is the escrow ledgers, which can be rebuilt from bank records
manual_workaround: Bank relationship manager and fraud desk by phone; branch deposit of checks; Broker-owner approves wires from a clean device; no disbursement on any instruction that has not been verified by a call to a known number
dependent_systems: SYS-04; SYS-02 (sales escrow ledger spreadsheet); SYS-05 (property management escrow ledger); SYS-07
dependent_third_parties: Escrow bank; property management platform vendor; productivity suite vendor; MSP

description: Email and phone with buyers, sellers, owners, tenants, title companies, and lenders; deposit instructions and wire fraud warnings; agent coordination
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Contract deadlines run daily. When the official channel is down or untrusted, clients look for another one and fraudsters supply it (P08). About 29 mailboxes carry most transaction traffic
manual_workaround: Office line forwarded to the Office Manager's cell phone; call clients from the numbers in the contract file; tell clients no wire instructions will come by email
dependent_third_parties: Productivity suite vendor; phone carrier; internet provider; MSP
dependent_people_or_facilities: Office Manager; Transaction Coordinators; contractor agents

description: Contracts, disclosures, compliance review, deadline tracking, e-signature, and deposit verification requests for about 190 sides a year
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Inspection, financing, and closing deadlines; Florida deposit verification within 10 business days (r. 61J2-14.008(2)(b)); broker files must be kept 5 years (Fla. Stat. 475.5015). The transaction platform vendor's SOC 2 report states RPO 1 hour, which meets the 4-hour target
manual_workaround: Paper addenda signed in person; deadline list printed weekly from SYS-01; e-signature from the vendor's site on any clean device
dependent_third_parties: Transaction platform vendor; e-signature vendor; title companies

description: Rent collection, owner statements and monthly distributions, maintenance requests, and tenant communications for about 85 homes
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Owner distributions run monthly; urgent maintenance (water leaks, no air conditioning in summer) must still be dispatched, which is the only safety-related impact; rents are due on the first of the month
manual_workaround: Urgent maintenance by phone to vendors from a printed list; accept rent by check at the office; delay distributions up to 3 business days with owner notice
dependent_third_parties: Property management platform vendor and its payment processor; escrow bank; maintenance vendors

description: Listing input to the MLS, listing photos and descriptions, website inquiries, and showing requests
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Listings and inquiries can wait one to three days with limited revenue loss; the MLS is run by the association, not the company
manual_workaround: Agents enter listings directly in the MLS; inquiries answered by phone
dependent_systems: SYS-02; SYS-07; MLS (association-provided, outside the boundary)
dependent_third_parties: MLS and local association; website host

description: Rental applications, screening reports, lease preparation, and move-ins
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About 280 applications a year, roughly 5 a week; a few days of delay costs vacancy days, not safety. Screening reports are consumer reports (FCRA)
manual_workaround: Hold applications in the queue; extend lease start dates with owner agreement
dependent_third_parties: Property management platform vendor; screening provider (integrated)

description: Agent commission payments after closing, payroll, operating account bills, and bookkeeping
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Agents expect commissions within days of closing; payroll is biweekly through the accounting SaaS export; a cash reserve covers about 45 days of expenses
manual_workaround: Manual commission checks from the operating account; repeat the prior payroll
dependent_third_parties: Accounting SaaS vendor; escrow and operating bank; payroll service

business_process: Agent onboarding, offboarding, and license compliance
description: Agent license and affiliation records, independent contractor agreements, account set-up and removal, broker supervision records
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: No daily dependency, but a departing agent's access must still be removed on the last day (P01 R-009); broker records must be kept 5 years (Fla. Stat. 475.5015)
manual_workaround: Paper checklist; account removal through the vendor admin consoles from any clean device
dependent_third_parties: Productivity suite vendor; transaction platform vendor; MSP
